_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil has held for 51 straight windows with 0% breakout rate, and neither brain has identified a confirmed breaker — analyst needs stablecoin growth >45 + funding <40 for UP or ETF flows <70 + BTC dominance fade <35 for DOWN, neither of which has triggered.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative leans bullish on squeeze potential but provides no concrete trigger, effectively leaving timing unquantified.
next_move.confirmed_if: Stablecoin growth reverses above 45 AND funding cools below 40 (UP breaker) OR ETF flows collapse below 70 AND BTC dominance fade reverses below 35 (DOWN breaker)
next_move.invalidated_if: Score breaks outside 55-62 band with sustained momentum, forcing phase reclassification beyond ±1 rung tolerance
